versions.changelog: Point users to the Chrome Web Store extension + LINE Bot; whitelist threads.com/threads.net/meta.com (Meta acquired threads.com in 2023 but some feeds still flag it).
Whitelist Taiwan financial sites (moneydj.com etc.) to fix false positive reports
Fix: move cache to ~/.cache/phishguard to prevent bloated installs
New name and description for better discoverability
Address security concerns: remove mandatory auto-scan, add privacy section, fix dependency metadata
Fix skill path issue + optimize startup speed: blocklist now fetched on-demand instead of downloading 54MB upfront

- Renamed the skill to "phishguard."
- Expanded description with multilingual support and detailed sources.
- Clarified that all URLs in a message are automatically scanned without user prompts.
- Provided detailed response templates for dangerous, suspicious, and safe URLs.
- Outlined data sources (38 total, including Taiwan 165, CERT.PL, PhishTank).
- Specified language behavior: default to Traditional Chinese, auto-match user's language.
- Added setup instructions for initial blocklist download.
